name: Salnotes Zero 2
accessories: Detachable cable (3.5mm, mic, or USB-C variants available)
pros: Improved bass quantity and texture over the original Zero
cons: Some prefer the more neutral original Zero
Technical performance remains at budget level
insight: Zero 2 (also called Zero:2) is the Crinacle-tuned sequel that adds roughly 3 dB more bass and calms the treble compared with the original. Most reviewers consider it a successful update that makes the set more engaging while retaining the clean midrange that made the first Zero famous. It is one of the safest and most frequently recommended IEMs under $30.
